newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goldfields Gas in Wiluna supply deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goldfields Gas in Wiluna supply deal.

text.p: Goldfields Gas Transmission Pty Ltd said on Thursday it had signed a six-year contract to supply gas to goldminer Wiluna Gold Pty Ltd's new power station.

The deal to send 2.1 terajoules of gas a day over the 864 km from Yarraloola to Wiluna in Western Australia was the first third-party gas transmission contract for the Goldfields Gas Transmission pipeline.
The gas will be used in a new power station to be built by Wiluna Gold, owned by Wiluna Mines Ltd, with deliveries to commence in the 1997 December quarter.
Goldfields Gas Transmission said that discussions with other prospective pipeline users were well advanced.
The 1,380-km pipeline was commissioned to link the gasfields offshore Western Australia to the state's eastern goldfields.

The pipeline was first used to transport gas exclusively to its three development partners, WMC Ltd (62.664 percent), The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (11.843 percent) and Gold Mines of Kalgoorlie Ltd (25.493 percent).
